test_title: PYST 28: SSC JE ME - Reasoning (Held on: 22 March 2021 (Evening)
subject: reasoning
question:
Select the option that is related to the third number in the same way as the second number is related to the first number.

13 ∶ 26 ∶∶ 14 ∶ ?
solution:
The logic follows here is;

**(First Number × 4) - 26 = Second Number**

In 13 : 26;

(13 × 4) - 26 

= 52 - 26

= 26

In 14 : ?;

(14 × 4) - 26

= 56 - 26

= 30

Hence, **"30"** is the correct answer.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f72be33799c08d3322a2907949d25e7543e352bc7880a277f6efed7f62d7c04b.png] 

**(Digit Sum of First Number × 4) + 10 = Second Number **

In 13 : 26;

[(1 + 3) × 4] + 10

= [4 × 4] + 10

= 16 + 10

= 26

In 14 : ?;

[(1 + 4) × 4] + 10

= [5 × 4] + 10

= 20 + 10

= 30

Hence, "30" is the correct answer.
